topic: Measles-rubella vaccination drive launched for 3.4 million children
headline_marked: 3.4mn kids to get vaccines in [[nationwide measles-rubella catch-up drive]]
headline: 3.4mn kids to get vaccines in nationwide measles-rubella catch-up drive
summary: The government has launched a special campaign to vaccinate children aged 6-59 months who missed previous rounds to prevent further outbreaks.
details: The government has launched a nationwide special measles-rubella vaccination campaign to cover children who missed earlier rounds. Health Minister Sardar Mohammad Sakhavat Hossain inaugurated the drive at the T&T sports ground in Dhaka on Saturday.
caption:
3.4 million children who missed their measles-rubella vaccines are now being targeted in a massive nationwide catch-up drive.

The government has launched a nationwide special measles-rubella vaccination campaign to cover children who missed earlier rounds. Health Minister Sardar Mohammad Sakhavat Hossain inaugurated the drive at the T&T sports ground in Dhaka on Saturday.

topic: Four arrested over attack on Radda health centre
headline_marked: 4 arrested after [[health centre demolished]] in Mirpur
headline: 4 arrested after health centre demolished in Mirpur
summary: Police arrested four suspects who allegedly took part in the late-night demolition of the Radda MCH and FP Centre in Mirpur-1.
details: Police have arrested four people over the demolition of an NGO-run health centre in Dhaka’s Mirpur-1. The arrests followed a series of raids on Friday night.

Investigators say the suspects admitted to taking part in the attack for money. Shah Ali Police Station chief Jahangir Hossain stated that while CCTV recordings were unclear, evidence of their involvement was found.
The Radda MCH office and health centre were demolished late Thursday night using heavy machinery. One permanent and three semi-permanent buildings were completely torn down.
After the demolition, the attackers put up a signboard for 'Somomona Dokandar Samity Ltd' (Like-minded Shopkeepers’ Association Ltd) in front of the property.
Radda alleges that office equipment and a large quantity of vaccination supplies were looted during the attack. The facility had provided free primary healthcare and maternity services for 50 years.
Radda Executive Director Nasrin Akhter has filed a case with Shah Ali Police Station. The case names local BNP leader Hanif Mia and 200 to 250 unidentified people as suspects.
caption:
Four people arrested after a 50-year-old health centre in Mirpur was demolished by heavy machinery for money.

Police have arrested four people over the demolition of an NGO-run health centre in Dhaka’s Mirpur-1. The arrests followed a series of raids on Friday night.

Investigators say the suspects admitted to taking part in the attack for money. Shah Ali Police Station chief Jahangir Hossain stated that while CCTV recordings were unclear, evidence of their involvement was found.

The Radda MCH office and health centre were demolished late Thursday night using heavy machinery. One permanent and three semi-permanent buildings were completely torn down.

After the demolition, the attackers put up a signboard for 'Somomona Dokandar Samity Ltd' (Like-minded Shopkeepers’ Association Ltd) in front of the property.

Radda alleges that office equipment and a large quantity of vaccination supplies were looted during the attack. The facility had provided free primary healthcare and maternity services for 50 years.

Radda Executive Director Nasrin Akhter has filed a case with Shah Ali Police Station. The case names local BNP leader Hanif Mia and 200 to 250 unidentified people as suspects.
